refinements.name: 踩踏事故
refinements.description: 队伍中任意友方单位攻击命中敌人时，队伍中所有友方单位的攻击力提升2.5%，最多叠加4层，持续8秒，每层效果单独结算持续时间，每名友方单位最多提供1层增益效果，同名被动效果之间不可叠加。
refinements.descriptionEn: When any friendly unit in the squad attacks and hits an enemy, all friendly units' ATK increases by 2.5% for 8s, stacking up to 4 times. The duration of each stack is calculated separately, and each friendly unit can provide 1 stack of the buff. Passive effects of the same name do not stack.

basic.name: 普通攻击：淑女的球棍
basic.trigger: 点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
basic.description:
点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多四段的打击，造成物理伤害和火属性伤害；
当露西发动[普通攻击]第四段时，场上的亲卫队小猪会一起发动[亲卫队小猪：回旋挥击！]。
basic.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Strike forward up to 4 times, dealing Physical DMG and Fire DMG.
When Lucy uses her fourth Basic Attack, the currently on-field guard boars will launch Guard Boars: Spinning Swing! together.

special.name: 特殊技：安打！
special.trigger: 点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
special.description:
点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
将亲卫队小猪召回并击出[平直球]，亲卫队小猪命中敌人或墙壁时引发爆炸，造成火属性伤害。
长按 【特殊技键】 发动：
将亲卫队小猪召回并击出[高飞球]，亲卫队小猪从空中落地时引发爆炸，造成火属性伤害。
special.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Recall a guard boar and launch it as a Line Drive. The guard boar will cause an explosion upon hitting enemies or walls, dealing Fire DMG.
Hold [Special Attack] to activate:
Recall a guard boar and launch it as a Fly Ball. The guard boar will cause an explosion upon landing, dealing Fire DMG.

ex.name: 强化特殊技：全垒打！
ex.trigger: 能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
ex.triggerEn: With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
ex.description:
能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
将亲卫队小猪召回并击出[平直球]，亲卫队小猪命中敌人或墙壁时引发爆炸，造成大量火属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果；
招式命中敌人时，将触发[快速支援]。
能量足够时，长按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
将亲卫队小猪召回并击出[高飞球]，亲卫队小猪从空中落地时引发爆炸，造成大量火属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果；
招式命中敌人时，将触发[快速支援]。
ex.descriptionEn:
With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Recall a guard boar and launch it as a Line Drive. The guard boar will cause an explosion upon hitting enemies or walls, dealing massive Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
When the skill hits an enemy, it triggers a Quick Assist.
With enough Energy, hold [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Recall a guard boar and launch it as a Fly Ball. The guard boar will cause an explosion upon landing, dealing massive Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
When the skill hits an enemy, it triggers a Quick Assist.

dodgeCounter.name: 闪避反击：獠牙折转！
dodgeCounter.trigger: 极限闪避时，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
dodgeCounter.triggerEn: Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
dodgeCounter.description:
极限闪避时，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动打击，造成火属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
dodgeCounter.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Strike enemies in front, dealing Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

chain.name: 连携技：大满贯！
chain.trigger: 触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
chain.triggerEn: When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
chain.description:
触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
露西起跳将场上亲卫队小猪打出，对前方大范围敌人造成大量火属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果；
招式命中敌人时，将触发[快速支援]。
chain.descriptionEn:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Lucy jumps up and sends a guard boar at enemies in front in a large area, dealing massive Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
When the skill hits an enemy, it triggers a Quick Assist.

ultimate.name: 终结技：再见全垒打！
ultimate.trigger: 喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
ultimate.triggerEn: When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
ultimate.description:
喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
将所有亲卫队小猪依次打出，对前方大范围敌人造成大量火属性伤害；
招式发动时，队伍中其他角色回复10点能量，下一名换入前场的角色额外回复20点能量；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果；
招式命中敌人时，将触发[快速支援]。
ultimate.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Launch all guard boars sequentially, dealing massive Fire DMG in a large area to enemies ahead.
While using this skill, other squad members recover 10 energy, and the next character to switch in gains an additional 20 energy.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
When the skill hits an enemy, it triggers a Quick Assist.

quickAssist.name: 快速支援：触身球！
quickAssist.trigger: 当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
quickAssist.triggerEn: When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
quickAssist.description:
当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动打击，造成火属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
quickAssist.descriptionEn:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
Strikes enemies in front, dealing Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable during the attack.

defensiveAssist.name: 招架支援：安全上垒！
defensiveAssist.trigger: 前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
defensiveAssist.triggerEn: When the character on field is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
defensiveAssist.description:
前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
招架敌人的攻击，累积大量失衡值；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
defensiveAssist.descriptionEn:
When the character on field is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

assistFollowup.name: 支援突击：触垒得分！
assistFollowup.trigger: 发动[招架支援]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
assistFollowup.triggerEn: Press [Basic Attack] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
assistFollowup.description:
发动[招架支援]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动打击，造成火属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
assistFollowup.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
Strikes enemies in front, dealing Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

facts.text: 当露西发动[特殊技]或[强化特殊技]时，亲卫队小猪会加入战斗并呼叫出另外两只亲卫队小猪；亲卫队小猪可以继承露西的攻击力、冲击力和异常精通；[加油！]对亲卫队小猪的增益效果提升至原本的200%，并使亲卫队小猪的攻击频率提升。
facts.textEn: When Lucy uses her Special Attack or EX Special Attack, a guard boar will join the battle and call in two other guard boars. The guard boars inherit Lucy's ATK, Impact, and Anomaly Proficiency. The Cheer On! buff for the guard boars is increased to 200% of the original effect, and their attack frequency is increased.

cinema.name: 队形操练中
cinema.description: 亲卫队小猪发动[亲卫队小猪：回旋挥击！]时，为露西回复2点能量，15秒内最多触发一次，每只亲卫队小猪单独结算冷却时间。
cinema.descriptionEn: When the guard boars launch Guard Boars: Spinning Swing!, Lucy recovers 2 Energy. This effect can trigger once every 15s, with each guard boar having its own separate cooldown.

cinema.name: 小猪大队长
cinema.description: 露西发动[连携技]或[终结技]时，将为全队角色、邦布和亲卫队小猪施加[加油！]状态，持续10秒。
cinema.descriptionEn: When Lucy uses a Chain Attack or Ultimate, it grants all squad members and Bangboo, and the guard boars themselves the Cheer On! status for 10s.

cinema.name: 铁腕监护人
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

cinema.name: 无规则球赛
cinema.description: 处于[加油！]状态下的友方单位，暴击伤害额外提升10%。
cinema.descriptionEn: While in the Cheer On! state, allies' CRIT DMG is increased by an additional 10%.

cinema.name: 荒原贵公主
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

cinema.name: 獠牙堪烈火
cinema.description: 处于[加油！]状态下的队友[强化特殊技]命中敌人时，一只亲卫队小猪会从空中落地引发爆炸，造成等同于亲卫队小猪300%攻击力的火属性伤害，并使全队角色、邦布和亲卫队小猪的[加油！]状态的持续时间提升5秒；持续时间最多提升3次，上限30秒，重新获得[加油！]状态时刷新可提升次数；亲卫队小猪落地引发爆炸后，将会发动一次[亲卫队小猪：回旋挥击！]。
cinema.descriptionEn: When another squad member in the Cheer On! state hits an enemy with an EX Special Attack, a guard boar will drop from the sky and cause an explosion, dealing Fire DMG equal to 300% of the guard boar's ATK. This will extend the duration of the Cheer On! buff for all squad members and Bangboo, and for the guard boars themselves by 5s. The duration can increase up to 3 times, with a maximum duration of 30s. Refreshing the Cheer On! state resets the stack count. After the guard boar's explosion, it will launch Guard Boars: Spinning Swing!.

basic.name: 亲卫队小猪：抄家伙！
basic.description: 战斗中，亲卫队小猪会随机使用棒球棍、拳套、弹弓，自动对敌人发动攻击， 造成物理伤害。
basic.descriptionEn: In combat, the guard boars will randomly use a baseball bat, boxing gloves, or a slingshot to automatically attack enemies, dealing Physical DMG.

basic.name: 亲卫队小猪：回旋挥击！
basic.description: 当露西发动[普通攻击]第四段，或自身获得[加油！]状态时，亲卫队小猪会挥舞棒球棍持续转圈，对周围敌人造成物理伤害。若无法立即发动，亲卫队小猪会记住所需发动次数。
basic.descriptionEn: When Lucy uses the fourth Basic Attack, or when she gains the Cheer On! status, the guard boars will whirl their baseball bats in a continuous motion, dealing Physical DMG to nearby enemies. If the attack cannot be executed immediately, the guard boars will remember the required number of times to execute it.

basic.description:

ex.descriptionEn: After using EX Special Attack, when a guard boar triggers an explosion, it will apply the Cheer On! status to all squad members and Bangboo, and the guard boars themselves. While under the Cheer On! status, allies' ATK increases by 13.8% of Lucy's initial ATK + 44, up to a maximum of 600. The Cheer On! status lasts for 10s when a Line Drive is hit, and 15s when a Fly Ball is hit. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

招式命中敌人时，将触发[快速支援]。
ultimate.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Launch all guard boars sequentially, dealing massive Fire DMG in a large area to enemies ahead.
While using this skill, other squad members recover 10 energy, and the next character to switch in gains an additional 20 energy.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
When the skill hits an enemy, it triggers a Quick Assist.

quickAssist.name: 快速支援：触身球！
quickAssist.description:
当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动打击，造成火属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
quickAssist.descriptionEn:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
Strikes enemies in front, dealing Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable during the attack.

115100005.name: 强化特殊技：全垒打！
115100005.description:
能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
将亲卫队小猪召回并击出[平直球]，亲卫队小猪命中敌人或墙壁时引发爆炸，造成大量火属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果；
招式命中敌人时，将触发[快速支援]。
能量足够时，长按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
将亲卫队小猪召回并击出[高飞球]，亲卫队小猪从空中落地时引发爆炸，造成大量火属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果；
招式命中敌人时，将触发[快速支援]。
115100005.descriptionEn:
With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Recall a guard boar and launch it as a Line Drive. The guard boar will cause an explosion upon hitting enemies or walls, dealing massive Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
When the skill hits an enemy, it triggers a Quick Assist.
With enough Energy, hold [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Recall a guard boar and launch it as a Fly Ball. The guard boar will cause an explosion upon landing, dealing massive Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
When the skill hits an enemy, it triggers a Quick Assist.
